variants.headline: The vote abroad went our way
body: The election we worked for in a small city-state has gone our way. Tellers read the last tally from the town hall steps, and the candidate we backed spent the evening shaking hands below them. Our friends there now hold the seats that matter.

variants.headline: The vote abroad went against us
body: Our push in a small city-state came up short. The count ran against us through the night, and the money sent ahead of it bought nothing but receipts. Whoever explains the loss should first say why the voters there preferred the other man.

variants.headline: The election in {{cityState}} goes our way
body: We are credibly informed that the contest in {{cityState}} has ended to our {{terms.civic.government}}'s credit. The crowd outside the council house has gone home, and the clerks inside are sorting the papers the campaign left behind. Our traders may expect a warmer hearing in that quarter for some years to come.

variants.headline: Make the case for meddling
body: We spent good coin to swing an election abroad and got nothing for it. Before the next purse is opened, the minister should name one advantage an open envoy could not have won. Failing that, let our people keep their money and let the voters of that town keep their own choice.

variants.headline: One number from a murky business
body: One figure survives all the talk of the election: our standing in that city-state moved by {{influence}}. The agents can argue about favors bought and promises broken. The ledger keeps only the difference the count made. Measured that way, the operation was a bargain or a warning, and the next proposal will be judged against this number.

variants.headline: Our diplomat takes up post in {{civilization}}
body: Our diplomat has taken up a post in {{civilization}}. The trunks went into the coach before dawn, and the dispatch case rode inside with the passenger. Letters to that court will now have a hand to carry them past the gatekeeper.

variants.headline: Our envoy takes a post at a major court
body: An envoy of ours is now seated at a foreign court. The porter at the coach yard was told to load the sealed pouches last, where the envoy could keep an eye on them. Whatever that court decides this season, we will hear it from a witness instead of a rumor.

variants.headline: An envoy established at {{capital}}
body: In this year an envoy of ours was received at {{capital}}, the seat of {{civilization}}. The gatekeepers gave him the usual courtesies, and the first dispatch went home before the week was out. Thus the custom of keeping a voice at every court is continued.

variants.headline: A diplomat goes to {{civilization}}
body: Our envoy is in {{civilization}} tonight, and the post at their court is filled. He will sit at their table and count what he hears. An ear at a foreign table is worth a company of soldiers, and costs a great deal less.

variants.headline: A foreign spy, caught and named
body: A foreign agent was taken in our territory, and the papers on him named the service that sent him. The magistrate read the seal twice, then called for wax and closed the file. A complaint will go out through the usual channel, and the other court will deny it through the usual one.

variants.headline: A foreign spy is killed in our streets
body: A foreign spy was caught at his work inside our borders and did not leave alive. The {{terms.civic.government}} has the name of the service behind him, though his family will be told only that he died abroad. The watch has said nothing more, and the file has gone to the archive.

variants.headline: Hear it! A spy is taken in {{cityName}}
body: Hear it, {{terms.civic.people}} of {{cityName}}! A stranger came to pry into this city's business, and your watch took him at his work. Taken, and stopped! Go about your business; the watch is awake.

variants.headline: A foreign spy uncovered!
body: Neighbors, our watch has caught a foreign spy in the city! The ministry has the name of the service behind him and will not print it. Ask your alderman why the rest of us hear of these things only after the danger has passed.

variants.headline: Seen at the work, but not named
body: One of our agents abroad has been noticed at his work. The other side has not traced him to us, and no complaint has reached our embassy. The watch there is asking questions at the ministry gate, and our people are keeping to their usual hours.

variants.headline: What {{target}} may hold back
body: The clerks in {{target}} know a spy was at work among them and do not know whose. So our envoy escapes a formal complaint, for now. The cost arrives in smaller ways: seals checked twice, pouches opened before they reach the desk, and our people in {{target}} waiting longer at every door. The ministry should answer why the agent was seen at all.

variants.headline: Our spy drew notice and may bring home {{possibleTechnology}}
body: Letters from our embassy relate that our agent abroad was seen at his work, and that the dispatches leave open whether he carried home {{possibleTechnology}}. The clerks there have spent the week answering questions about unfamiliar callers. If the notes he brought out are sound, the stir will have been worth the risk.

variants.headline: One of ours is marked in {{cityName}}
body: In this season our agent was marked at his work in {{cityName}}. The watch there questioned the porters at the gate and let the matter rest. What he carried away, if anything, is not set down in this record.

variants.headline: A foreign spy, seen and unnamed
body: A foreign agent has been seen at work inside our borders. Our watchers have not yet learned who employs him, and the embassy quarter has grown quiet. The watch house has doubled its rounds until the matter is settled.

variants.headline: The spy who died unnamed
body: Our watchers killed a foreign spy at his work, and he died before anyone could name his master. The body was taken away before the market opened. Somewhere a handler waits for a report that will never come, and cannot ask after it without showing his hand.

variants.headline: Notice: the watch is awake
body: Notice is given that our watchers have marked a foreign agent at work within our borders. His employer is not yet known. The {{terms.civic.government}} asks householders to report strange callers and to keep their own counsel while the inquiry runs.

variants.headline: Someone was watching {{cityName}}
body: Somebody has been poking around {{cityName}}, and it is nobody from this street. A foreign spy was spotted at work, and nobody can say who paid him. The market did good business all the same, though every stranger at a stall got a second look.

variants.headline: Named abroad, and the doors close
body: The other side has named one of our agents abroad. Our embassy learned of it before any note arrived, which tells its own story. The cipher that agent used has been burned, and the ashes are already out with the morning sweep.

variants.headline: Killed abroad, and known to them
body: Word came from abroad this week that one of our agents was killed in service, and the other side knows whose. At the ministry an archivist wrote 'ended' across the file and put it away without a word. The rest of the story will stay inside those walls.

variants.headline: Our spy is killed abroad, unnamed
body: An agent of ours was killed at his work abroad, and the watchers there never learned who sent him. No complaint will follow, and no name will be printed. The loss stays inside the service, and the file will not be opened again.

variants.headline: The ministry owes us its account
body: The government of {{target}} has named one of our spies, and our own ministry has said nothing. Silence leaves our citizens to take the foreign account on trust, which is a poor bargain for a nation that pays for a service. Let the minister state what public good the operation served. The names of the agents can stay out of it.

variants.headline: The cost of the quiet work in {{target}}
body: An agent of ours is dead in {{target}}, and {{target}} knows whose agent he was. Such work is paid for twice over: first in the man, then in the trust between courts, and both debts fall due at once. What the operation bought in return, no one outside the service can say. The nation should ask before it pays again.

variants.headline: A winter coat passed on
body: The agent died in service abroad, at the work he was sent to do. At his old lodgings, the landlady gave his winter coat to a traveler and recalled a night when he had done the same for a stranger. The service keeps its own record of his name.

variants.headline: Our spy may have gained {{possibleTechnology}}
body: Our agent finished the work abroad without being seen. The first reports say he may have brought {{possibleTechnology}} with him. If they hold, the forges and workshops will show it within the month.

variants.headline: The quiet account
body: The work abroad, entered plainly:
Watchmen who raised an alarm: none. Goods likely gained: {{possibleTechnology}}.
Set against that: the years of study we did not have to spend.

variants.headline: Unnoticed in {{target}}
body: Our people worked in {{target}} tonight and no alarm was raised. Word from the service says the take may include {{possibleTechnology}}. If that holds, the distance in learning between the two nations is shorter by a step. No workshop in either country will be told why.

variants.headline: Quiet win: possibly {{possibleTechnology}}
body: Nobody saw our agent. Likely gain: {{possibleTechnology}}. That is the whole report, and it is a good one.

variants.headline: One of ours has taken rooms in {{cityName}}
body: A quiet agent of ours now lives in {{cityName}}, a city of {{civilization}}. A rented room above a shop gives a view of the gate and a back stair to the alley. The {{city.owner.civic.government}} there keeps its own hours, and our agent means to learn them.

variants.headline: A quiet posting to {{cityName}}
body: Be it known that one of our people now keeps a post in {{cityName}}, a city of {{civilization}}. Letters sent by the accustomed route will reach our agent. The first report home will describe what visitors to that city are never shown.

variants.headline: One of ours goes to {{cityName}}
body: It is told that a quiet one of ours has gone to {{cityName}}, in the land of {{civilization}}. The market there will see a new stall, and the gate a new face. When the wind turns, we will hear what the road carries.

variants.headline: A room inside {{cityName}}
body: Our agent in {{cityName}} has the one thing no dispatch from {{civilization}} can supply: a window that stays open. Count the wagons that pass it each morning and you learn what {{civilization}} is moving before it announces anything. The question is whether the traffic at that gate is ordinary trade or supplies for a new road being built in secret. Either answer is worth having.

variants.headline: A diplomat of {{civilization}} arrives at our capital
body: An envoy of {{civilization}} has taken up residence in our capital. The gatekeeper at the foreign ministry has a new face to learn and a new line for the visitors' book. Questions that used to wait on a courier now have a door to knock on.

variants.headline: A foreign diplomat arrives
body: A foreign diplomat has arrived and taken a house near the capital's ministry. The clerks are still deciding which office should call on him first. Until they do, he will hear a great deal from the servants and very little from us.

variants.headline: An envoy from {{civilization}} at our court
body: We are pleased to record that an envoy of {{civilization}} is now received at our capital. A fresh page has been ruled in the reception ledger, and the ink is still wet under his name. Words carried by an envoy arrive with fewer dents than words carried by rumor, and this court has need of straight words.

variants.headline: A listener at our table
body: An envoy of {{civilization}} now keeps rooms in our capital. Hospitality costs us little, but an open door costs more than wine. Let the steward pour, and let the clerks lock the study. A guest who is watched politely will write a cautious report home, and a cautious report is no gift to his masters.
